    print(f"Format: {p_str!r}")
    print(f"  Regex: {p._expression}")
    results = list(parse.findall(p_str, test_str))
    print(f"  Results: {[(r.fixed[0], r.fixed[1]) if len(r.fixed) > 1 else (r.fixed[0],) for r in results]}")
    print()
